name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for waiver of the immunity of Mariusz Kamiński
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided to lift the legal protection that Mariusz Kamiński, a Polish member of the European Parliament, holds as an elected representative. Polish prosecutors want to charge him with breaking a court-ordered ban on holding public office. They say he attended sessions of the Polish parliament in December 2023, after a court had banned him from public office for five years. Lifting his protection lets the Polish case go ahead.

- Polish prosecutors can now pursue their criminal case against Kamiński.
- It affects Kamiński, who loses his protection from prosecution in Poland.
- The Parliament's President sends the decision to Polish authorities and to Kamiński.
